I couldn't reproduce the bug, so I haven't changed anything. `median([1, 2, 3, 4])` returns `2.5` with the code in `src/stats_utils.py`. I ran it to confirm. The function sorts the list and averages the two middle values when the length is even.

The users may be running a different version than this checkout, such as an older release or an installed copy of the package. Another possibility is that their call goes through a different function than this `median`. The real bug could also be integer division (`//`) in the user's own code or an older version.

If you can tell me which version or environment they're using, or give me an example call that fails, I can look into it further.
